__introCard.headline: Who paid for the beers?
__introCard.sub: See the balance from the team's Bunq account, top up in two taps, and see who keeps the pot full.

__outroCard.sub: Admins connect the team's Bunq account under Team settings.

__intro: Who paid for the beers? Ask the team pot.
Who paid? Who still owes? Just open Money.
The team pot, live from its Bunq account: There's the team pot, | live from the team's Bunq account.
What it buys in beers, | and how it moved over time.
Chipping in? Tap Top up, and pick twenty euros.
You pay on the team's bunq dot me page.
Back in the app, | your twenty euros are in.
Spent money from the pot? Add the receipt.
Now the whole team can see what it was for.
Paid by bank transfer? Tell the pot it's yours.
Link the name and IBAN, so the next one: Link the name and the I-ban, | so the next transfer links itself.
So who keeps the pot full?: So, | who keeps the pot full?
Press play, and watch the ranking grow.
Two linked transfers later, you're on to: Two linked transfers later, | you're on top!
__outro: Try it today! Open Money, top up, and keep the pot full. See you at TeamBalance dot N L!
